author: RookieRoll

comments.body: can you please explain why need to send empty tools and empty content to api? I mean in which situation you need to do this, thanks.

> can you please explain why need to send empty tools and empty content to api? I mean in which situation you need to do this, thanks.

First, your rest api is supporting empty tools.
Second, your assistant's documentation allows the developer to set up tools, which makes it impossible to predict what the user will do, even emptying the tools is possible, but the sdk restricts this, which makes it impossible for the developer to completely clear out the tools, at least one will remain, and the developer will be able to use the tools to set up the user's own tools, which is not the expected result. This is not the expected result.
Third, about Empty content, this piece can be divided into two main parts. One is whether or not to allow Empty content, which you can do if you want; the second is that you shouldn't give an exception when the content is empty, because the developer gives wrong information about the role. This makes it hard for the developer to know what's wrong.
